explanation: Compare corresponding nodes recursively. Both must be null, or their values and both pairs of subtrees must agree.
timeComplexity: O(min(a,b)+1) node comparisons for tree sizes a and b, stopping at the first mismatch.
spaceComplexity: O(h) recursion space up to the smaller traversed height.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 Java algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
